sql.query: SELECT rp.id grantId FROM tbl_user_tenants ut INNER JOIN tbl_user_tenant_roles utr ON utr.userId=ut.userId AND utr.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=utr.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='tenant.teams.members.manage' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE ut.userId=:userId AND ut.tenantId=:tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active' LIMIT 1

sql.query: SELECT tm.id teamMemberId,tm.teamId,t.teamName,tm.isPrimary FROM tbl_team_members tm INNER JOIN tbl_teams t ON t.id=tm.teamId AND t.tenantId=tm.tenantId WHERE tm.userTenantId=:userTenantId AND tm.tenantId=:tenantId AND tm.isActive=1 ORDER BY t.teamName

SELECT tm.teamId,tmr.teamRoleId,tr.teamRoleName FROM tbl_team_members tm INNER JOIN tbl_team_member_roles tmr ON tmr.teamMemberId=tm.id AND tmr.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_team_roles tr ON tr.id=tmr.teamRoleId AND tr.teamId=tm.teamId AND tr.tenantId=tm.tenantId WHERE tm.userTenantId=:userTenantId AND tm.tenantId=:tenantId AND tm.isActive=1 ORDER BY tm.teamId,tr.teamRoleName
